user.title: What do you want to track?
user.description: Each login becomes its own device with its own sensors.

claude.title: Log in with Claude
claude.description:
1. [Open this link]({url}) and log in with the Claude account you want to track.
2. Approve access. You are shown a code (it contains a `#`).
3. Paste the entire code below (or the full URL of the page).

Home Assistant gets its own login and does not share tokens with Claude Code or the Windows app.

chatgpt.title: Log in with ChatGPT
chatgpt.description:
1. [Open this link]({url}) and log in with the ChatGPT account you use in Codex.
2. After approving, the browser is sent to a `localhost:1455` page that cannot load. That is expected.
3. Copy the **full URL** from the address bar (it contains `code=`) and paste it below.

Home Assistant gets its own login and does not log Codex out.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Access to {service} has expired or was revoked. [Open this link]({url}), log in with the **same** account and paste the code (Claude) or the full URL from the address bar (ChatGPT) below.

reconfigure.title: Renew login
reconfigure.description: [Open this link]({url}), log in to {service} with the same account and paste the code (Claude) or the full URL from the address bar (ChatGPT) below.

error.missing_code: Paste the code from the login page.
error.state_mismatch: The code belongs to another login attempt. Use the link on this page.
error.invalid_code: The code was rejected or has expired. Open the link again and paste a new code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the login service. Try again shortly.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different account than this entry tracks.

init.title: Claude Timer options
init.description: The usage API rate-limits hard (a block can last for hours), so keep the interval at 5 minutes or more.
